stories.title: Expose EvaluateCare Facade via FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Integrate evaluate_care_facade into the FastAPI application layer, enabling API endpoints for clinical trials search and provider detail retrieval consistent with existing tool invocation patterns.

stories.title: Integrate EvaluateCare Facade with Tool Router
stories.description: Register evaluate care operations within tool_router to ensure validated inputs are dispatched to evaluate_care_facade and responses are returned in Anthropic tool_use format.

stories.title: Unit Test EvaluateCare Facade Orchestration Logic
stories.description: Develop unit tests to validate that evaluate_care_facade correctly orchestrates calls to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, including success and failure paths.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for EvaluateCare Flows
stories.description: Implement integration tests covering full evaluate care flows from tool_router through facade to domain services, validating schema compliance, orchestration, and response integrity.
